column4: Keeps the display-only client name on its own session; nothing reads it to decide access, routing or attribution.
Reads the clock for the process start shown on the Gateway page; decides nothing.
Builds the start facts the Gateway page shows; decides nothing.
Elapsed seconds since start, for display; decides nothing.
Start time, for display; decides nothing.
The version change recorded at start, for display; decides nothing.
Stores the start-time refusal snapshot for display; decides nothing.
Reads that snapshot for display; decides nothing.
Start facts for a state built without a server start; decides nothing.
The host name resolved at start, for display; decides nothing.
Reads the host name from the environment or kernel, for display; decides nothing.
The kernel node name, for display; decides nothing.
No node name off Unix; decides nothing.
Saves the counters file now (startup and shutdown); a failed save is logged and decides nothing about a request
Restores the health history and saves it once before serving; reports health, never refuses a request or a start
Chooses where this run saves health.json (nowhere when an unreadable file could not be moved aside); decides nothing about access
Starts the background task that samples memory and sessions for the health history; records numbers only
